clue.text: In which poor income is choking firm and credit is squeezed

definitions.text: In which poor income is choking firm and credit is squeezed

indicators.note: squeezed means pressed into a tight space, so credit and the second is go into the middle
choking means gripping round the throat, so the jumbled letters close around the firm
poor here means in bad shape, so the letters of the word income are knocked into a new order

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
taken as written
CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gloomy description of hard times: wages squeezing businesses and lending drying up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poor' makes ENOMIC; 'choking' wraps it round CO, giving a word meaning financial; the second piece of 'squeezed' text then sits before the final IS. The whole clue lists symptoms of a downturn.
explanation.definitionFit: Falling wages, struggling businesses and a credit squeeze are the classic symptoms of a financial downturn.
